title: Identity and composition for tensor-formula module pullback
statement: Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:X\to Y$ and $h:Y\to Z$ morphisms, and for any morphism $a:A\to B$ among them let $P_a:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_B)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_A)$ be the pullback functor whose value on a sheaf of modules $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is $P_a\mathcal G=\mathcal O_A\otimes_{a^{-1}\mathcal O_B}a^{-1}\mathcal G$, using inverse image of sheaves [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] and the sheaf tensor product/change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and whose action on morphisms is induced by inverse image and tensor product. Then there are natural isomorphisms of functors $P_{\mathrm{id}_X}\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)}$ and $P_{h\circ g}\cong P_g\circ P_h$.

source.place: Tag 0097, lemma-push-pull-composition-modules (lines 3189-3202), with the identity case from Tag 0095, definition-pushforward (lines 3116-3141) and uniqueness of left adjoints used in the proof of lemma-pullback-composition (lines 2209-2223)

proof.text: Obtain the tensor adjunction for the identity scheme map by the composite Hom equivalence of [lem-pc-module-change-of-rings-adjunction] and [lem-pc-module-inverse-image-adjunction], as implemented by nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction in this module. Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId identifies its right adjoint with the identity functor. Transport along that isomorphism with Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight. Apply the uniqueness of left adjoints, the identity-right-adjoint special case of [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], against Adjunction.id from [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. This gives nonempty_tensorPullbackId.

proof.text: Obtain the tensor adjunctions for g, h, and g followed by h using [lem-pc-module-change-of-rings-adjunction] and [lem-pc-module-inverse-image-adjunction], as implemented by nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction. Compose the h and g adjunctions using [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. Transport their right adjoint with Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight along Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h. The transported composite and the tensor pullback along g followed by h have the same right adjoint. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq, the same-right-adjoint case of [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], gives nonempty_tensorPullbackComp.
